result.summary: This PR adds four new Boost unit tests to src/test/pow_tests.cpp, each specifically designed to kill a mutant found by a mutation-testing tool that current tests fail to catch. The mutants cover use of GetBlockTime vs GetMedianTimePast in GetNextWorkRequired, an integer type change in CalculateNextWorkRequired, rounding behavior in PermittedDifficultyTransition, and the missing non-retarget height check in PermittedDifficultyTransition. The author recommends reviewing per commit, and each commit maps to one specific mutant/test pair.
result.problem: Existing pow_tests.cpp coverage has gaps that let subtle mutations in consensus-relevant code (difficulty adjustment and validation) go undetected, which matters to anyone relying on the correctness of difficulty retargeting and to reviewers of future pow.cpp changes.

result.card: This PR adds four targeted unit tests to src/test/pow_tests.cpp, each written to kill a specific mutant found via mutation testing that existing tests miss, touching GetNextWorkRequired, CalculateNextWorkRequired, and PermittedDifficultyTransition. It closes real coverage gaps in consensus-relevant difficulty-adjustment code, per the description one gap concerns a dropped non-retarget height check and another a rounding comparison in PermittedDifficultyTransition. Reviewer brunoerg gave detailed nits, the author addressed them with a force push, and brunoerg then ACKed the final commit, so agreement is strong and the PR is ready for further review.
